Description: Static page generation minification stripped HTML comments (<!-- -->) which React SSR uses as node boundaries between adjacent text literals and JSX expressions
Impact: Caused React invariant error #425 on /cases/ during hydration
ActionTaken: Fixed by converting adjacent text nodes to ES6 template literals across all dynamic labels in CasesPage.tsx

Description: CSS fluid clamp (clamp(30px, 9.1vw, 40px)) allowed 3-line headline wrap on mobile viewports while client title-prefit JS expected 2 lines, causing post-hydration font shrinkage and 41px layout shift
RootCause: CSS clamp bounds were not aligned with headline character count and max-width
ActionTaken: Re-calibrated clamp to clamp(26px, 7.8vw, 33px) ensuring 2 lines across 320px-480px viewports

Description: Curated case studies (concierge & luxury niches) use static webp assets in public/images/ which bypassed the CMS ARTICLE_IMAGE_MANIFEST preload generator
RootCause: Missing static lookup table in generate-pages.js resolveArticleCoverPreload
Impact: Case studies suffered +150ms image discovery delay
ActionTaken: Implemented STATIC_CASE_PRELOADS in generate-pages.js to inject high-priority responsive preloads

Area: Trailing Slash Normalization in Route Loader
Description: articleInitialLoad in routes.tsx used strict string equality location.pathname === '/cases' instead of trailing slash normalized path
RootCause: Exact string mismatch against canonical trailing slash URL /cases/
Impact: Triggered redundant dynamic fetch for article data on static catalog visit
ActionTaken: Normalized route pathname in loader logic
